basis: Whole-sign/classical horary per Lilly, 2nd-house rules: Venus, lady of the Ascendant, near Regulus gives honourable rise; Mars, lord of the 2nd and lord of the Part of Fortune, in the Ascendant near Spica puts wealth in the querent's own hands and by his own labour. Jupiter exalted in Cancer, angular and almost culminating, promises great and lasting substance through his profession and eminent patrons. The Moon, lady of the 10th, separates from sextile of Mars and conjunction of Mercury and applies to conjunction of Venus, the querent's own significator — gain flows from career to himself, with no 7th/8th-house testimony for wealth by marriage. Continuance: cusp of the 2nd in a fixed sign and the Part of Fortune in a fixed sign in the terms of Mars, its lord placed in the Ascendant.
prediction_text: Yes — he shall be rich, and subsist of himself without marriage. The wealth comes by his own industry and trade/vocation, with the favour and employment of great or wealthy men, not by a wife's portion. It will be substantial and honourable, and it will continue/endure rather than be quickly spent.
timing: In years: wealth is attained in about six to seven years, keyed to the Moon, lady of the 10th, wanting 6°27' of her conjunction with Venus, lady of the Ascendant; accumulation is gradual up to that perfection, not immediate.
